newsitem.title: USA: GM to announce truck production changes.
newsitem.headline: GM to announce truck production changes.

text.p: General Motors Corp will announce Friday a series of production moves for its Truck Group, including a committment to build a new version of its full-size pickup trucks in Flint, Mich., a GM spokesman said.
GM will disclose the decisions at an 1100 EST news conference in Pontiac Mich.

The automaker also expects to announce plans to close a small assembly plant in Detroit that produces truck chassis for recreational vehicles and buses. The chassis production will be consolidated at the Flint truck plant.
Workers at the Detroit facility are expected to be shifted to GM's nearby Cadillac assembly plant, located in the Detroit enclave of Hamtramck, Mich., the GM spokesman said.
The changes mark a major victory for the Flint plant, which was once in danger of closing because GM had not assigned it a future product to build.
The plant now builds large, "crew-cab" four-door pickup trucks for commercial buyers and built GM's previous generation of full-size vans. GM now produces the vans in Wentzville, Mo.
